title: 德国联邦宪法法院句子级解释准则分类基准
summary: 本文构建了句子级基准，评估LLM对Larenz解释准则的分类能力，提供德国联邦宪法法院判决标注数据集，并对比四种LLM在专家提示与GEPA优化提示下的表现，平均F1为70.4至79.2。
summary_en: This paper presents a sentence-level benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to classify interpretive canons per Larenz, with an annotated dataset of German Federal Constitutional Court decisions and baseline evaluations of four LLMs under expert-written versus GEPA-optimized prompts, achieving mean F1 of 70.4-79.2.
